annotation.bound_parties_text: The working paper binds no one; it is a US submission discussing humanitarian benefits of emerging technologies in lethal autonomous weapons systems, and says States should encourage such innovation.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Rather than trying to stigmatize or ban such emerging technologies in the area of lethal autonomous weapon systems, States should encourage such innovation
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Humanitarian benefits of emerging technologies in the area of lethal autonomous weapon systems
